game.title: Dead Island
game.blurb: Open-world zombie action RPG from Techland, published by Deep Silver, released 2011-09-06. RAWG average playtime: 7 hours. Genres: Action, Shooter, RPG. Chapters are an estimate drawn from Steam achievement themes (Definitive Edition list), following the four acts it names.

chapters.title: Acts 1 and 2
chapters.summary: Finishing act 1 and act 2, and act 1 with all four characters.

chapters.title: Acts 3 and 4
chapters.summary: Finishing act 3 and act 4, the end of the story. Spoiler-guarded.

chapters.title: Quests, Survivors and Levels
chapters.summary: Finishing quests, saving besieged survivors, levels 10, 25 and 50, and coming back after 28 days.

chapters.title: Exploring Banoi and Collectibles
chapters.summary: Exploring the whole island, driving and walking long distances, and finding 60 and 120 collectibles.

chapters.title: Weapon Mods and Loot
chapters.summary: Customising weapons, fire and thunder mods, modified-weapon kills and Exceptional Weapons.

chapters.title: Combat and Special Infected
chapters.summary: Melee and firearm kill counts, headshots, fire, grenades, Fury attacks, limbs, medkits and the Ram, Butcher and Suicider.

chapters.title: Co-op
chapters.summary: Joining other players, playing with four characters and finishing quests with partners.

chapters.title: The Arenas
chapters.summary: Surviving waves in each of the four Arenas, alone and in co-op.

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 28492); RAWG keeps "Dead Island Definitive Edition" (2016-05-31) separately. The Steam store list has no plain "Dead Island" app; it has "Dead Island Definitive Edition" (383150), the edition on sale, so that app was used. Its schema is named "ValveTestApp91310" (a placeholder name with a different number) and one achievement description names "Dead Island - Definitive Edition", so the list is the Definitive Edition one. None of the 57 Steam achievements is hidden. StrategyWiki has "Dead Island" at completion stage 0 (marked as a stub): only Achievements and trophies (about 9,500 characters) and Table of Contents are written; Gameplay, Controls and Walkthrough are linked but not written. deadisland.fandom.com answers the API under "Dead Island" with about 95 linked articles; names only were looked at, nothing copied. Splitting the four acts into two chapters is our own choice. "Right 4 Life" (act 1 with 4 characters) sits with Acts 1 and 2. "Fancy" (waves with custom weapons) sits in the Arenas chapter because it counts waves.
